changes: Failed correlated Fast results are now freshness-checked and decoded through their native error before success-only acquisition fields are required.
Successful Fast results retain the same strict session, request-parameter, geometry, response/restoration, exact-footprint and exact-10000-AOI union validation.
Recoverable Fast retries log target/row/attempt and detailed malformed-footprint shape only in live production-backed runs, not deterministic fixture runs.
A bounded same-owned-session Dispatch stress proof was added for repeated cross-server Fast acceptance.

deterministicAcceptance.newRegression: An early state=failed Fast result with missing success-only target/view/hold fields exhausts three local attempts and preserves the native failure text instead of being misclassified as a request-parameter mismatch.

interpretation.finding: The investigation found a distinct intermittent early overview-session admission gap that was previously masked as a parameter mismatch. The existing bounded retry recovers it. The historical all-three-attempt non-rectangular footprint did not recur across 14 full server-2207 scans, so no speculative AOI reset/re-anchor was added.
interpretation.remainingDiagnosticIfItRecurs: Malformed-footprint retries now report exact target, row band, rows, columns, count and indices, so a future recurrence can be repaired from the actual native shape without weakening coverage.
